Name: Sebastian's Garage
Author: LadyEleven
Description:
If you marry Sebastian, he gushes about how much his life has improved. His own space, more freedom, love, respect. But this belies a hidden defect in the beautiful façade of his married life. A tale of neglect, of regression. Robin's house may have been full of unpleasant memories for Sebastian, but it had one thing he could never get on the farm - [i]until now[/i].

A garage.

Sebastian's beloved motorcycle, literally the vehicle of his romance, his stalwart steed, his symbol of freedom, languishes out in the open once he is married. Coated in pollen in the spring, drenched in summer thunderstorms, vulnerable to falling autumnal pinecones, buried under winter blizzards. And Sebastian says nothing, acts as though it's all fine. But it's not fine. That bike deserves better.

So now, I present the option to rectify this architectural and spiritual failure. I give you:

[size=4]Sebastian's Garage

[/size]The actual art for the garage itself, as you may have noticed, is largely lifted from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Pathoschild's Tractor Mod[/url], although I recolored the roof to match the building mods I use (Lumisteria's lilac [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/196]custom buildings[/url]) - along with some other recolors now - and added some minor seasonal touches. The art also needed to be tweaked in several ways to make it truly "fit" in the spouse patio area and so Sebastian's bike actually fits in there (and so Sebastian himself looks right when he's actually out there working on the bike).

The garage has some seasonal variation and some customization options that can be modified either through the config.json file that generates after you run the game with the mod loaded for the first time, or through the in-game mod config menu. You can select from three different styles: gray roof, lilac roof, red roof, and whether in winter you'd like snow or ice on the roof.

If anyone would like to take what I've done and make their own version, that's fine (again, the garage assets aren't mine anyway, the bike is ConcernedApe's, so the only thing I really did was mush them together, add the seasonal clutter, and then write the content file).

This mod now relies only on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]! And of course, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].

[b]Updates:[/b]
06/30/2024 - I have finally reworked this mod so that it uses the new built-in tools for modifying spouse patios! I am sorry it took me so long, a lot of life happened. Because of the new tools, though, I had to squish the garage down a bit to fit in the designated spot. However, the big upside to this is that in theory it should be compatible with all farm types! I haven't actually gotten to test that myself, and if you find a compatibility issue please let me know, but now this mod should edit Sebastian's spouse patio wherever a map happens to place it.

Downloads.Description: This file now includes all possible options and can be configured to set customization choices. This mod requires Content Patcher and SMAPI.
